description: Look up artists, albums and songs in TheAudioDB, the free music database built by its community. Get an artist's biography in one of 15 languages, their photos, logo and fan art, an album's cover, year, rating and review, and a song's length, mood, tempo, key and music video. Search by name, or go straight to a record with its TheAudioDB number or MusicBrainz ID. No account or API key required.
